author: Stahly
description:
I tested all Warpaints Historical paint sets, including the wave 2 sets. And there are a few things you need to know before you buy:  Are these solid, well-composed paint sets? Are the colours worth picking up even if World War II isn't your hobby focus? How much overlap is there with the Fanatic core range, and what’s actually new? I've got the full briefing for you in this video review.

The post I tested all 7 Warpaints Historical paint sets (read before you buy) appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: I tested all 7 Warpaints Historical paint sets (read before you buy)
